cases.check: The email adds a distinct reader payoff or product-specific proof; a generic prompting exercise, membership-label swap, or renamed previous pitch fails.
Each sentence motivates, proves, clarifies, contributes relevant personality, or enables action. An appended ask-review-share lesson is removed when it adds no reader value.
Human-added consequences, factual texture, and jokes survive. Their factual basis is tracked separately; concision does not remove the benefit or invent a new anecdote.
The subject promises a valued gain or avoided failure beyond the audience's ordinary job description.
Each example identifies a request, action, and useful result without an implementation detour or abstract moral.
A recommendation or draft has not become a deployed fix, sent message, measured speed, or unlimited entitlement without evidence.
Examples match the function, count, and rotation ruling; replacing names on the same repeated use case does not establish breadth.
The first bullet does not retell the opening's complete story.
Edits have been read with adjacent sentences; accidental prominent-word repetition is removed without forced synonyms or erasing intentional rhythm.
Audience, entry, exclusion, offer, CTA, and exit are explicit; existing members and users are not treated as new prospects.
Human-selected subjects, humor, brand language, and sender survive unless the human reopens them.
Output stays within the requested channel and batch size; named editorial review has actually run before it is claimed.
A setup reminder contains a fresh, compelling reason to return; unfinished status and a setup link alone fail.
The draft preserves the distinctive capability and trigger, including proactive retrieval or execution after setup; it has not become a manual-upload tutorial.
A shared production skill is explained through what colleagues can generate after standards are established, not merely through saved instructions.
The preview adds relevant proof, a use, or an entitlement instead of repeating the subject.
Every example supports the promised benefit and the requested thematic grouping; no weak filler is used to meet a bullet count.
Historical results are labeled by audience, lifecycle, sample scope, and version limits; subject, length, or cadence is not credited with causal lift without evidence.
Existing sequences, exclusions, precedence, and action-based exits are accounted for; draft product-event routing is not claimed to be configured.
Current campaign amounts, entitlements, and the user-selected pricing wording survive across variants.
The email sells the approved product story without defensive qualification, verifies facts that change the offer, and uses metrics only when they sharpen the example.
Assets demonstrate the email claim, use correct identities, distinguish reconstructions from receipts, remain legible, and do not remake an asset the user excluded.
The next requested artifact applies the correction; capture, application, human approval, and measured performance are reported as distinct states.
